scanner_definitions.name: Momentum Leaders
scanner_definitions.description: Identifies top-decile equities in strong multi-month uptrends trading above rising 50-day and 200-day moving averages.
scanner_definitions.rule_summary: Close > SMA50 > SMA200 AND 3M Return > 8% AND Within 8% of 52W High

scanner_definitions.name: Pullback to Key Support
scanner_definitions.description: Catches controlled pullbacks into rising 20-day or 50-day moving average support while long-term trend remains upward sloping.
scanner_definitions.rule_summary: Close > SMA200 AND Slope200 > 0 AND Distance to SMA20/50 <= 2.5% AND RSI 42-58

scanner_definitions.name: 52-Week High Breakout
scanner_definitions.description: Securities testing or exceeding 52-week highs on abnormal institutional trading volume.
scanner_definitions.rule_summary: Close within 2.5% of 52W High AND RVOL >= 1.15x AND Close > SMA20

scanner_definitions.name: Volatility Squeeze (Bandwidth)
scanner_definitions.description: Bollinger bandwidth compression inside historical low ranges indicating an imminent directional breakout.

scanner_definitions.name: Institutional Accumulation (CMF+OBV)
scanner_definitions.description: Detects persistent smart-money accumulation through positive Chaikin Money Flow and rising On-Balance Volume.
scanner_definitions.rule_summary: CMF(20) >= 0.07 AND OBV Slope > 0 AND RVOL >= 1.0x

scanner_definitions.name: Mean Reversion (Oversold Bounce)
scanner_definitions.description: Extreme short-term oversold condition where price pierces lower Bollinger Band with RSI < 36.

scanner_definitions.name: Stacked Moving Average Alignment
scanner_definitions.description: Textbook bullish alignment where Price > 20EMA > 50SMA > 200SMA with positive long-term slope.
scanner_definitions.rule_summary: Close > SMA20 > SMA50 > SMA200 AND Slope200 > 0

scanner_definitions.name: Low-Volatility Trend Quality
scanner_definitions.description: Defensive low-volatility trend leaders with controlled ATR drag and steady compounding trajectory.

scanner_definitions.name: Fast & Medium MTF Alignment
scanner_definitions.description: Fast 8EMA leading 21EMA above intermediate 50SMA supported by established trend strength (ADX > 22).
scanner_definitions.rule_summary: EMA8 > EMA21 AND Close > SMA50 AND ADX(14) >= 22.0

scanner_definitions.name: High Relative Volume Surge
scanner_definitions.description: Unusual volume expansion greater than 1.6x the 20-day baseline, indicating institutional catalyst.

scanner_definitions.name: Consolidation Base Tightening
scanner_definitions.description: Price consolidates tightly near 52-week highs with declining volatility, building energy for continuation.
scanner_definitions.rule_summary: BB Bandwidth < 10.0% AND Within 12% of 52W High

scanner_definitions.name: Daily Range Expansion
scanner_definitions.description: Wide-range expansion bar exceeding 1.4x the 14-day ATR while closing above 20-day moving average.

scanner_definitions.name: 50-Day Moving Average Support Bounce
scanner_definitions.description: Intraday low tests institutional 50-day moving average with closing buyers defending key support.
scanner_definitions.rule_summary: Low <= SMA50 AND Close > SMA50 AND Close > Low

scanner_definitions.name: Canadian Market Leader
scanner_definitions.description: Premier Canadian equities on the TSX outperforming broader indices with strong quarterly momentum.
scanner_definitions.rule_summary: Country == CA AND Within 6% of 52W High AND 3M Return > 5%

scanner_definitions.name: TAC-15: PO3 Liquidity Sweep & Manipulation Reversal
scanner_definitions.description: Detects institutional accumulation sweeps where intraday manipulation undercuts prior swing low or key moving average support to trap sellers before closing strongly back inside the range.
scanner_definitions.rule_summary: Golden Cross Alignment (SMA20 > SMA50 > SMA200) AND Low <= SMA20/50/LowerBB AND Lower Wick >= 25% AND Close in Upper 50% AND RSI 40-66
